non_applicable_dimensions.queues-jobs-dead-letters-ordering-backpr: No queue, broker, job runner, or background worker exists in the changed paths. Delivery is a synchronous subprocess chain inside one foreground process and Orchestrate dispatches units by calling launch directly with no thread pool, asyncio, multiprocessing, or queue anywhere in the module, so there is no asynchronous work item that could be duplicated, reordered, poisoned, or dead-lettered.

non_applicable_dimensions.pagination-rate-limits: The change exposes no collection interface with paging, cursors, quotas, or throttling. The only two list reads the launcher performs are single-shot local-socket calls returning their whole result in one object, with no page token, no limit parameter, no ordering guarantee to preserve, and no rate-limit signal in the response shape. The launcher owns no network service and serves no clients, so there is no volume boundary to score.

evidence: coordinator-executed: the two colour resets each return True and dim text after them is returned as staged
findings.suggested_fix: Track attributes rather than one boolean.
findings.title: Colour-reset codes wrongly end an intensity span
findings.why_it_matters: The commit calls the new predicate the terminal's own, but under ECMA-48 the two colour-reset codes leave bold, dim, italic and underline in force. Treating either as ending the span means text that is still visibly dim is classified as unstyled operator input, turning a placeholder into a hard stop.

evidence: plugins/agent-launcher/skills/agent-launcher/scripts/launcher.py:1187 the sole caller always passes the floor
plugins/agent-launcher/skills/agent-launcher/scripts/launcher.py:962-965 the transcript appears only after preflight
findings.suggested_fix: If the stop is intended, correct the docstring that still promises a fallback.
findings.title: Transcript fallback no longer degrades, it stops
findings.why_it_matters: The recency floor is correct and kills a real false pass, but it makes the second account proof unreachable at the only production call site, because the transcript is written when the first prompt arrives -- after preflight. On a machine that does not paint the statusline, every accounted launch reaches no evidence, and the account check then closes the session and raises.

evidence: executed: a real timeout and a real exit with that code are indistinguishable by code alone
findings.suggested_fix: Require the synthesised shape too before claiming a timeout.
findings.title: Wrapper exit 124 is reported as a timeout
findings.why_it_matters: The helper synthesises that code for an expiry and the launch branches on the code alone, so a wrapper genuinely exiting with it gets a timeout message and has its output discarded. A discriminator is already available and unused: the synthesised result carries a distinctive marker.

findings.suggested_fix: Print the program and a count of remaining arguments, or redact credential-shaped entries.
findings.title: Launch failure prints argv the skill calls credential-bearing
findings.why_it_matters: The skill gains a rule in this diff saying argv is not guaranteed free of credentials and must never be inspected wholesale. The create-failure path interpolates the full argv, including operator-supplied launch args, into a stop message that Orchestrate persists into the run state file.

findings.suggested_fix: Run the identity half of preflight before the guard.
findings.title: Guard stops on a session herdr has not yet confirmed
findings.why_it_matters: After the reorder the guard runs on nothing but a pane id parsed from wrapper stdout: the kind, working directory, workspace and account stops all live in verify_unit_preflight, which now runs afterwards. A stale pane id yields a staged-input message instead of the more diagnostic identity stop.

findings.suggested_fix: Keep the structural rules and the negative controls; drop the phrase pins.
findings.title: Documentation tests couple to exact SKILL.md wording
findings.why_it_matters: A documentation-only unit carries 186 test lines, most of them exact-substring assertions on prose. Any reword breaks tests that describe nothing about program behaviour, and the failures will be uninformative. The three meta-tests proving the detectors fire are the sound part.

evidence: plugins/agent-launcher/tests/test_launcher_contract.py _guidance_fences reads only the skill section and the README
findings.suggested_fix: Extend one guard to scan the launcher for whole-argv interpolation.
findings.title: Secret-safety guards scan documentation, never the code
findings.why_it_matters: The secret-safety contract is enforced by four text guards whose input is the guidance prose and the plugin README. No guard can see the launcher, so a code path that emits a credential-bearing string satisfies every guard while violating the rule they exist to protect.

recommended.reason: the diff adds a subprocess create deadline and a 124 branch, a bounded pane read, a clock-based transcript recency floor, and changes close-failure handling
new receipt keys, changed return shapes on four launcher functions, a new Orchestrate unit field, a new nonzero CLI exit path, and a dependency floor rise
one unit exists because the skill document made a false claim about what --dry-run validates, and four units edit that same document in sequence

non_applicable_dimensions.queues-jobs-dead-letters-ordering-backpr: No queue, broker, job runner, or background worker exists in the changed paths. Delivery is a synchronous subprocess chain inside one foreground process and Orchestrate dispatches units by calling launch directly with no thread pool, asyncio, multiprocessing, or queue anywhere in the module, so there is no asynchronous work item that could be duplicated, reordered, poisoned, or dead-lettered.

non_applicable_dimensions.pagination-rate-limits: The change exposes no collection interface with paging, cursors, quotas, or throttling. The only two list reads the launcher performs are single-shot local-socket calls returning their whole result in one object, with no page token, no limit parameter, no ordering guarantee to preserve, and no rate-limit signal in the response shape. The launcher owns no network service and serves no clients, so there is no volume boundary to score.
